label: blocking producer DMA completion events
hypothesis: Use blocking CUDA completion events for producer host-buffer reuse, reducing CPU consumption during DMA waits and potential competition with lookup/model submission.
expected_bottleneck: Instrumented frozen A0001 producer event waits consume 13.1856/59.5677 ms thread CPU time within 13.2182/59.8416 ms wall wait at b1/b8. Overlapping wait spans are not additive removable model latency.
change: Create only pipeline copied events with blocking=True. Keep GPU consumed events, producer ordering, CPU gathers, group size/depth and all buffer capacities unchanged. Bulk decode stays unchanged.
tradeoffs: Sleeping waits may introduce wakeup latency; lower CPU usage is not itself a retained optimization.
Require lower target prefill wall latency and absolute offload gap under the original independent confirmation.

mechanism_observation: At b8, instrumented producer waits still span 60.2107 ms wall but consume 0.2281 ms thread CPU, versus A0001 59.8416 wall / 59.5677 CPU. This validates reduced CPU consumption, not model latency benefit.
screen_decision: b1 prefill offload and gap reductions 0.140985/0.148229 ms vs A0001; b8 prefill slower 0.356781 ms with gap worse 0.174065 ms.
